Title: Deck Idea: Sylvester Simms Slip and Slide

Messages.Author: brandonsantacruz
Messages.Body:
Has anyone ever made Sylvester into the star of a turbo deck? Here's sort of what I'm thinking:

Sylvester Simms
[ani][dom][AUS][OBF]
Malkavian
Capacity: 8
Group: 1
Camarilla primogen: If Sylvester goes into torpor, each Methuselah burns 1 pool.

If you can land Sylvester in torpor every turn, that's one pool damage to everyone at the table. Add to that a bleed of 3-5, some bounced bleeds, and some weenie support and it looks like you could do a good job of ousting. I'm thinking that Sylvester needs a Fortitude skill card, or at least Agent of Power. He plays Daring The Dawn or Day Operation on his bleed to give +1 pool damage around the table to his bleed. Someone rescues him, maybe a weenie obf dom dude, and he is ready to do it again next turn.

There are a variety of tools to help with blood and torpor management. Here are a few:

Perfectionist
The Coven
Life in the City
Giant's Blood
Asylum Hunting Ground
Humanitas
The Catacombs
Secret Passage

Is this simply a case of junking up Malk 94, or could this be viable? What are your thoughts?

Be careful when you fight the monsters, lest you become one.
-Friedrich Nietzsche
